method.order: Three warmup pairs excluded, then ten AB/BA alternating pairs; smoke uses one pair without warmup
method.lifecycle: One DB connection per variant/pair: cold initial fill, then same-connection unchanged and independent append samples
method.restoration: After initial fill, checkpoint and copy DB seed; source tail/mtime restored after each sample; before next scenario an unmeasured refresh accepts restored DTO state, then persistent main tables restored from ATTACH seed on same connection; all restoration excluded from timing
method.cache: A is frozen original SQL TEMP; B retains per-file source DTO snapshots on its DB connection. File-level incremental: changed files reread from start, unchanged related sources reuse accepted DTOs; cold reopen rebuilds required sources; OS cache warm, no forced GC
method.refresh: refreshSummary including required session COMMIT, excludes DB open, source preparation, restore and correctness checks
method.nestedClocks: reader includes processBatch; SQL prepare and memory aggregation are alternative paths, final store follows; do not add nested reader/parse clocks
method.counters: Actual read rows/bytes and aggregate input DTO references; TEMP schema statements counted during refresh, B must be zero; retained cache heap sampled only in diagnostic runs
method.memory: memoryAfter includes retained source cache; process high-water includes earlier scenarios, query validation and restore; diagnostic batch samples can miss transient peaks
method.queries: All pages of day/month/session/project APIs after initial fill, three warmups plus ten timed calls per sample; completed-request average denominator unchanged
method.migration: One separate M run of B on the original SQL seed; initial label is an unchanged seed acceptance check, then five independent updates plus cold reopen; strict facts/aggregate checks, excluded from timing summaries
method.coldReopen: One extra codex-1 refresh per variant/pair after seed restore and DB close/reopen; correctness and cold-cache diagnostic, excluded from warm timing summaries
method.inputs: Only frozen snapshot copies are appended; raw source paths/content excluded from published report; full file hashes checked before/after dataset

datasets.name: synthetic-10000-multi-source
datasets.generator: ordinal-v1; alternating providers; ten projects; fourteen days; fixed requests per session
datasets.multiSource: One Codex source duplicated under lexically later sibling path plus 16 MiB ignored progress rows; same 10,000 logical requests; append chooses original source
datasets.correctness: A/B requests, tokens, complete normalized facts, aggregate pages, independent JS group averages, cold/warm reopen, raw/rollup queries, FK/integrity and restored input hashes passed. Literal metadata/dependency hashes recorded but excluded: B recomputes complete affected aggregates instead of metadata dependency pruning.
